title: D&D Landscaping
subtitle: Fresh Cut builds clean and is fully pushed, but ddlandscaping.pro is LIVE today serving Dalten's legacy site. Go-live is a cutover, and the ballpark pricing quoting real customers needs his sign-off first.

items.what: Create an Upstash Redis and set KV_REST_API_URL + KV_REST_API_TOKEN
items.how: Without it, booking leads live in lambda memory and die on redeploy, and the visualizer queue and its daily cap cannot function.
items.label: console.upstash.com → Create Redis

items.what: Resend key + LEAD_NOTIFY_FROM on a verified sender
items.how: Today a booking request would email NOBODY, silently. The code logs and swallows it by design.

items.what: Strip FAL_KEY and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from Production env
items.how: FAL_KEY is actively harmful: the visualizer picks fal (exhausted wallet) over the free path. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is a stale canopy leftover.

items.what: Verify NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Production equals https://ddlandscaping.pro
items.how: Set 55 days ago in the canopy era. A wrong value poisons every canonical, sitemap URL and JSON-LD id.

items.what: Vapi wallet top-up + set the public key in Production, or Augustine ships as the browser-voice tour
items.how: Degrades gracefully without it. Not a launch blocker.

items.what: Google Search Console + Bing verification, and claim the Google Business Profile
items.how: Nothing is wired. GBP is the highest-leverage local move.

items.what: Pick analytics (Vercel Analytics is the one-line default)
items.how: The site currently ships with zero measurement.

groups.name: 2 · The Cutover (Destructive, Gated On Dalten)
groups.note: Flipping the domain takes his current live site down.

items.what: Make a shareable preview so Dalten can review Fresh Cut
items.how: Previews are behind Vercel SSO today (302 for him).

items.what: Deploy fresh-cut to Production on the canopy project once env is set
items.how: Build is clean, tree is pushed, nothing is blocking but the keys.

items.what: Approve the domain flip, then Claude detaches ddlandscaping.pro + www from the legacy project and attaches them to Fresh Cut
items.how: THE destructive step. Timed with Dalten's consent, ideally same-hour as his go-ahead.

items.what: Create the missing www DNS record at Name.com and redirect to apex
Decide the legacy project's fate after cutover (redirect or delete)
No placeholder copy, no dead links, favicon/OG/robots/sitemap/llms.txt present, real phone + email consistent everywhere
Fix the JSON-LD image array in app/layout.tsx: it points at /images-fal/* which does not exist (two 404s)
Rewrite the stale README (it still describes the canopy build)
Port /welcome + the owner's manual from canopy-standard
items.how: The client-handoff standard requires it; it was never brought over to fresh-cut.

items.what: APPROVE THE BALLPARK PRICING. Highest-risk item on this list
items.how: The site quotes real numbers to real customers: lawn $45 + $60/acre, cleanup $280 + $120/acre, mulch $210 + $95/acre, and the FAQ says "$50 to $75 a visit" out loud. These are our assumptions until he blesses them.

items.what: Confirm the SPEC tier SLAs are promises he will honor
items.how: 48hr / 24hr / same-day storm response, monthly photo walk reports. These read as contractual.

items.what: Real job photos (every image today is AI-generated, labeled representative)
Real reviews for the proof section (it holds the slot honestly for now)
Google Business Profile access + any social links
Street address + zip, so the map data stops being a downtown approximation
Founder letter in his own voice + overall copy approval
Consent to the cutover date (his current site goes dark at that moment)
